name: s390_sthyi
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_s390_sthyi, unsigned long function_code, void *resp_buffer, uint64_t *return_code, unsigned long flags);
Note: glibc provides no wrapper for s390_sthyi(), necessitating the use of syscall(2).
description: The s390_sthyi() system call emulates the STHYI instruction to provide hardware resource information for the machine and its virtualization levels, such as CPU type, capacity, and machine model. It uses a function code to specify the type of information to retrieve and stores results in a response buffer.

parameters.name: function_code
parameters.description: Indicates which function to perform, e.g., STHYI_FC_CP_IFL_CAP for CPU and IFL capacity information.

parameters.name: resp_buffer
parameters.description: Address of the response buffer to store the results; must be one page (4K) for certain functions.

parameters.name: return_code
parameters.description: Pointer to store the return code of the STHYI instruction, such as 0 for success or 4 for unsupported function.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Reserved for future extensions and must be set to 0.

return_value.success: Returns a value in the range [0..3] indicating the condition code of the STHYI instruction; 0 means success with data in resp_buffer.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error.

errors.description: The value specified in resp_buffer or return_code is not a valid address.
The value specified in flags is nonzero.
Allocating memory for handling the CPU capacity information failed.
The value specified in function_code is not valid.
